name: Crypto & Blockchain Compliance
description: Regulatory compliance, AML/CFT, licensing, and investigation tools for crypto-asset service providers (CASPs), VASPs, stablecoin issuers, DeFi protocols, and financial institutions active in digital assets. Covers MiCA, TFR Travel Rule, EBA crypto guidelines, FATF VA guidance, and blockchain forensics.

modelTier.notes: Crypto regulatory analysis requires maximum accuracy — MiCA articles and FATF guidance must be cited precisely. Opus 4.6 default for all analytical modules. Sonnet acceptable for quick briefings.
